meta_description: ZK Electrical Sheffield provides reliable domestic and commercial electrical work across Sheffield. Expert fault finding, rewiring, and installations. Call 07877 257897.
hero_subhead: From faulty sockets to full rewires, ZK Electrical fixes it fast. Same-day callouts across Sheffield.
services_subhead: Whether it's an emergency repair, a full rewire, or a new installation, we've got the expertise to get it right.

services.title: Emergency Electrical Repairs
services.desc: Blown fuses, dead sockets, or a tripped consumer unit? We diagnose and fix faults fast, often on the same day. No job too small.

services.title: Full House Rewires
services.desc: Upgrading an old installation or dealing with outdated wiring? We'll rewire your home safely to modern standards with minimal disruption.

services.title: Fault Finding & Testing
services.desc: Intermittent faults and mystery trips can be dangerous. We trace the source and fix it properly — not with temporary fixes.

services.title: New Installations & Extensions
services.desc: Adding a new kitchen, bedroom, or garage? We'll plan and install your wiring and circuits to code, on time and on budget.

services.title: Consumer Unit Upgrades
services.desc: Old fuse boxes are a fire and shock risk. We replace them with modern, safer consumer units and full circuit protection.

services.title: Commercial & Industrial Work
services.desc: Shops, offices, and factories need reliable wiring. We handle installations, maintenance, and compliance testing for businesses across Sheffield.

about_pullquote: I started ZK Electrical because I was tired of cowboys charging three times the going rate.
about_para_1: ZK Electrical has been serving Sheffield for 18 years. Zamir Khan founded the business on the principle that honest work and fair pricing should go hand in hand. Today, we've completed over 2,000 jobs across the city — from emergency repairs in family homes to full commercial installations.
about_para_2: Our customers return because we do the job right the first time. We turn up when we say we will, explain what's wrong in plain English, and charge exactly what we quote. We're NICEIC-approved and fully insured, so you know the work meets building regulations and your home is protected.
reviews_heading: What Sheffield Customers Say About ZK Electrical

reviews.text: Had a complete rewire done last summer. Zamir and the lads were tidy, professional, and finished bang on schedule. They explained everything as they went and the price was fair — no hidden charges. Couldn't ask for more really.
reviews.author: David M.

reviews.text: Called them out on a Saturday evening when our kitchen went dark. They arrived within an hour, found a faulty circuit breaker, and had us back up and running. Brilliant service. Will definitely use them again.
reviews.author: Helen T.

reviews.text: Zamir came to test our electrics before we sold the house. He found a couple of minor issues, gave us a full report, and was really helpful about what needed sorting. Honest bloke — didn't try to oversell us. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: James P.
